title: A move with two equally plausible candidates
why: ADVERSARIAL. The source file is gone and two files now carry an indistinguishable occurrence. There is no evidence that prefers either; a mapper that picks one is reporting its sort order as a finding. The case also exercises the symmetry: refusing on the A side leaves both B occurrences unexplained, and each of them is unresolved in its own right rather than quietly dropped or promoted to new.

expect.note: two candidates, no evidence prefers either
it may be the moved occurrence or it may be a birth; the same ambiguity, seen from B
symmetrical with occ-b1 - neither may be resolved without resolving the other

forbid: leaving occ-b1 or occ-b2 out of the record entirely - an unexplained occurrence is a stated unresolved, not a silence
